messages.subject: Reply served - Pennington v Tregarth
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

Our Reply has been served. It pleads (a) that Tregarth is estopped from denying incorporation of ES-4471 given Brian Tovey's 26 February confirmation, (b) that the failures across many pumps/operators/sites are inconsistent with the misapplication alleged, and (c) that the defect was latent so there was no acceptance.

Next step is the case management conference on 12 June, where directions to trial will be set.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
